title: Restore Companion settings across sessions and unify browser-to-cloud workspace adoption
body:
### Restore Companion settings across sessions and unify browser-to-cloud workspace adoption

```yaml
id: P-66d0b256-307b-4a9d-babd-13d6e7edd9f6
priority: 107
status: Pending
parent_pending_ids: []
processing_run_id: null
root_task_id: null
related_task_id: null
relation: main
depends_on: []
```

Description:
- Investigate owner-reported new-session behavior after settings sync: the Codex and ChatGPT checkboxes appear reset, and task Workspace and Notes cloud setup must be repeated. Audit persistence and restoration for newer settings. Replace the independent browser/cloud source model with one active account-bound Workspace shared consistently by task and Notes workflows.

Expected behavior:
- Browser storage is selected automatically before an explicit cloud choice; no manual Workspace setup is required for ordinary local work.
- Explicit cloud selection and the required disclosures move all existing browser records into the selected cloud Workspace, including tasks, organization and Notes with retained content, history and associations. After verified handoff, cloud becomes the sole active source and ordinary UI no longer offers the browser source. Interrupted transfer, conflicts and existing cloud records must not lose or silently overwrite data or leave two writable authorities.
- A new authenticated Companion session restores the selected Workspace and previously approved connection/settings state through verified account-bound recovery. Distinguish persisted preferences, actual server consent/grants and renewable session access; unavailable or revoked access must not appear as reset preferences. No new credential-storage consent, client grant, executor opt-in or Habitica effect follows ordinary settings sync.
- Replace the message "Choose the exact workspace. Browser and cloud records remain independent." and related task/Notes setup controls with clear single-Workspace behavior. Audit newer settings for missing synchronization and implement missing behavior.
- Evaluate a simple explicit cloud-to-browser return and implement the return if safely achievable within the scoped work; otherwise record the concrete remaining decision. Preserve records and prevent concurrent execution or duplicated effects during any return.
- Intended Codex/ChatGPT adoption and recovery steps require reviewed MCP parity with identity checks, explicit review where required and original-receipt recovery.

Current context:
- SettingsPage.razor currently describes tab-local management access and explicit account verification; NotesCloudClient holds session access in memory. CloudSyncSection does not list integration or Workspace/Notes connection settings. TodoWorkspacePresentation.RefreshSourcesAsync lists browser and cloud sources independently and emits the quoted message. Current UX/feature documentation explicitly says source switching does not upload Notes. These observations establish current contracts, not the root cause of the reported session behavior. No matching Pending, Prioritized or Backlog task was found; wider client qualification and Notes folders are adjacent work, without an inferred dependency. Process Pending must research restoration, consent-safe adoption, exact project/Notes identity preservation, transfer recovery and reverse-transfer feasibility before implementation.

Source:
- Project-owner request in Codex chat on 2026-10-30: settings appear lost after new-session sync, Codex and ChatGPT checkboxes and task/Notes Workspace setup do not persist; browser is the default single Workspace, explicit cloud choice moves browser records and removes the ordinary browser option; consider a simple reversible return.

Priority rationale:
- Owner-requested highest queue priority on 2026-10-30: repeated session setup causes substantial inconvenience despite noncritical severity. Priority 107 exceeds every other open task.
